d:
Taarak calls Jethalal at Gada Electronics to warn him that Iyer suspects him of making dozens of late-night missed calls to Babita. Furious at the accusation, Jethalal considers confronting Iyer, but Taarak advises him to stay calm and not get personally involved.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
